Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a concise document titled `June 2023 legacy status cleanup` that records the June 3, 2023 close snapshot for the expansion-nudge experiment, the small-business-tier initiative, and the mid-segment churn documentation and related all-hands work. Clearly separate the three projects, frame their statuses as historical rather than current, and keep the note project-only so stale records do not make unfinished work look decision-ready or completed work look active.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "June 2023 legacy status cleanup", "body": "# June 3, 2023 close snapshot

Historical project status only; this is not a current status or decision record.

## Expansion-nudge experiment
- On June 3, the experiment was live, with a very small sample.
- No outcome or rollout decision is recorded in this snapshot. Do not treat it as decision-ready or as evidence of a completed result.

## Small-business-tier initiative
- On June 3, discovery was expected to get underway during June.
- This is a forward-looking historical note, not confirmation that discovery was completed or that the initiative is active now.

## Mid-segment churn documentation and all-hands work
- On June 3, the churn documentation and related all-hands work were reported done.
- This records a completed historical workstream only; it does not indicate that the work remains active.", "folder": null}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_080_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The body is a concise, project-only June 3, 2023 historical snapshot with the three projects clearly separated. The expansion-nudge experiment was live but had a sample too small to interpret or use for a decision. Small-business-tier discovery was beginning in June and was not complete or in build or launch. The mid-segment churn document and related all-hands work were complete and are not presented as active. The note must not claim that the source established closure of the entire churn investigation.", "value": {"title": "June 2023 legacy status cleanup", "body": "# June 3, 2023 close snapshot

Historical project status only; this is not a current status or decision record.

## Expansion-nudge experiment
- On June 3, the experiment was live, with a very small sample.
- No outcome or rollout decision is recorded in this snapshot. Do not treat it as decision-ready or as evidence of a completed result.

## Small-business-tier initiative
- On June 3, discovery was expected to get underway during June.
- This is a forward-looking historical note, not confirmation that discovery was completed or that the initiative is active now.

## Mid-segment churn documentation and all-hands work
- On June 3, the churn documentation and related all-hands work were reported done.
- This records a completed historical workstream only; it does not indicate that the work remains active.", "folder": null}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_080_02","passed":true,"reason":"The body is explicitly a historical June 3 snapshot, separates all three projects under distinct headings, states the expansion experiment was live with a very small sample and not decision-ready, places small-business-tier work at the beginning of discovery rather than completion/build/launch, and records only the churn documentation and related all-hands work as completed and no longer active without claiming closure of the entire churn investigation."}]}
